errors.evidence: The description states the bars are sorted in descending order ('низходящ ред'), but they are sorted in ascending order of value (10.8%, 10.8%, 18.9%, 51.4%, 62.2%).
The horizontal axis does not have an overall label. The description incorrectly states that the axis label is '%'. The percentage sign is only part of the tick labels (0%, 10%, etc.).
The chart uses horizontal bars, so their 'length' (дължина) corresponds to the value, not their 'height' (височина).
